title: Roller skate with a smiling face
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- boot body -->
  <path d="M20,30 Q18,18 30,16 L60,16 Q68,16 68,24 L68,48 L28,52 Q20,52 20,44 Z" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- boot ankle/cuff lighter shade -->
  <path d="M20,30 Q18,18 30,16 L60,16 Q68,16 68,24 L68,32 L20,36 Z" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <!-- boot toe cap -->
  <path d="M20,44 Q18,52 28,54 L40,56 Q36,48 28,46 Z" fill="#e05588"/>
  <!-- sole -->
  <rect x="18" y="53" width="52" height="8" rx="3" fill="#c73b6f"/>
  <!-- sole edge lighter -->
  <rect x="18" y="53" width="52" height="3" rx="2" fill="#e87aa3"/>
  <!-- laces -->
  <line x1="34" y1="26" x2="50" y2="24" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="34" x2="52" y2="32" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="42" x2="54" y2="40" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d="M30,26 L54,24 L54,46 L30,48 Z" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <!-- eye left -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="34" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="35" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2b2d6b"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="33" r="1.8" fill="#9fe8ff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M46,42 Q52,48 58,42" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="42" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff88b0"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="40" rx="3.5" ry="2.2" fill="#ff88b0"/>
  <!-- truck (axle mount) -->
  <rect x="30" y="61" width="32" height="6" rx="3" fill="#a0a8b8"/>
  <!-- trucks lighter highlight -->
  <rect x="30" y="61" width="32" height="2.5" rx="2" fill="#c8d0e0"/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="74" r="9" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="74" r="4.5" fill="#ffb800"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="74" r="2" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="74" r="9" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="74" r="4.5" fill="#ffb800"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="74" r="2" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <!-- toe stop -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="58" r="6" fill="#8effc1"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="58" r="2.5" fill="#3ddc84"/>
</svg>
